newsitem.title: USA: Great Western says consent undetermined.
newsitem.headline: Great Western says consent undetermined.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp said the outcome of H.F. Ahmanson and Co's consent solicitation is still undetermined.
The consents and revocations will be reviewed and tabulated by an independent inspector of elections and certified results will be announced when the tabulation has been completed.
Earlier, Ahmanson said it received consents for a majority of shares on three out of five proposals, including a proposal requiring Great Western to hold its annual meeting by May 6.

Ahmanson cited support for a proposal to prohibit Great Western from adjourning a meeting with a quorum unless all business brought before it was acted on by shareholders and another proposal prohibiting Great Western's board from amending by-law amendments adopted pursuant to Ahmanson's consent solicitation without prior approval of shareholders.
Great Western said the outcome will be not be clear until the tabulation is completed and remains committed to a merger, announced March 6, with Washington Mutual Inc.

Great Western said the record date for three of Ahmanson's five proposals is March 13 and that Ahmanson introduced its two remaining proposals, one which would require Great Western to open negotiations with Ahmanson and another proposal related to the granting of certain termination fees.
Great Western said no record date for the additional proposals has been set.
